name: Xiaomi MiTV-MFTR0 (freeguy, MediaTek mt9653), China firmware OS2.0.23.0.RFTMATV (HyperOS TV 2)
warnings: Notes from this firmware: - The standby/screensaver ads come from com.xiaomi.mitv.hyper.screensaver, same as on OS3: a plain Activity with its own downloaded carousel; screensaver_enabled=0 does not touch it. com.mitv.screensaver / com.xiaomi.mitv.advertise don't exist. - Keep com.xiaomi.mitv.smartpanel enabled (it is the Menu-button panel: source switcher + wireless tiles).
